def VTask.piEquivPiSubtypeProd {α : Type*} (p : α → Prop) (β : α → Type*) [DecidablePred p] :
    ((i : α) → β i) ≃ ((i : {x // p x}) → β ↑i) × ((i : {x // ¬p x}) → β ↑i) := by
  classical
  have h : ∀ (a : α), (p a) ∨ (¬p a) := by
    intro a
    by_cases h : p a <;> simp_all [h]
  -- Define the forward direction of the equivalence
  have f : ((i : α) → β i) → ((i : {x // p x}) → β ↑i) × ((i : {x // ¬p x}) → β ↑i) := by
    intro f
    constructor
    · -- First component: {x // p x} → β ↑x
      intro ⟨a, ha⟩
      exact f a
    · -- Second component: {x // ¬p x} → β ↑x
      intro ⟨a, ha⟩
      exact f a
  -- Define the inverse direction of the equivalence
  have g : ((i : {x // p x}) → β ↑i) × ((i : {x // ¬p x}) → β ↑i) → ((i : α) → β i) := by
    intro ⟨f₁, f₂⟩ a
    have h₁ : (p a) ∨ (¬p a) := h a
    cases h₁ with
    | inl h₁ =>
      -- Case: p a is true
      have h₂ : (⟨a, h₁⟩ : {x // p x}) = (⟨a, h₁⟩ : {x // p x}) := rfl
      have h₃ : f₁ ⟨a, h₁⟩ = f₁ ⟨a, h₁⟩ := rfl
      exact f₁ ⟨a, h₁⟩
    | inr h₁ =>
      -- Case: p a is false
      have h₂ : (⟨a, h₁⟩ : {x // ¬p x}) = (⟨a, h₁⟩ : {x // ¬p x}) := rfl
      have h₃ : f₂ ⟨a, h₁⟩ = f₂ ⟨a, h₁⟩ := rfl
      exact f₂ ⟨a, h₁⟩
  -- Prove that the compositions are identities
  have h₂ : Function.LeftInverse g f := by
    intro f
    funext a
    have h₃ : (p a) ∨ (¬p a) := h a
    cases h₃ with
    | inl h₃ =>
      -- Case: p a is true
      have h₄ : g (f (⟨a, h₃⟩ : {x // p x})) = f (⟨a, h₃⟩ : {x // p x}) := rfl
      simp_all [f, g]
      <;> aesop
    | inr h₃ =>
      -- Case: p a is false
      have h₄ : g (f (⟨a, h₃⟩ : {x // ¬p x})) = f (⟨a, h₃⟩ : {x // ¬p x}) := rfl
      simp_all [f, g]
      <;> aesop
  have h₃ : Function.RightInverse g f := by
    intro ⟨f₁, f₂⟩
    ext <;> simp_all [f, g]
    <;>
    (try aesop) <;>
    (try {
      intro a
      have h₄ : (p a) ∨ (¬p a) := h a
      cases h₄ with
      | inl h₄ =>
        simp_all [f, g]
        <;> aesop
      | inr h₄ =>
        simp_all [f, g]
        <;> aesop
    }) <;>
    (try {
      aesop
    })
  -- Construct the equivalence
  exact {
    toFun := f
    invFun := g
    left_inv := h₂
    right_inv := h₃
  }
